name: foozle-radio
description: Development orchestration for the Foozle Radio frontend and backend

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix backend && npm audit --prefix frontend
